131d2a7c58.why: The widened loads, products, saturated subtraction, maximum/XOR result, mask update, accumulator update and index update are all needed, with no shorter AVX2 fusion.

c12bc92a77.why: All computed outputs are live, and AVX2 has no unsigned saturating dword subtraction to replace the maximum/subtraction pair.

acf3858ccf.why: The two broadcasts and two scalar updates each produce a distinct required output.

fa9c009c54.why: The loaded zmm20 value, both extrema and the updated index are all required, so folding the load into an extremum would lose a live output.

5649e6a02b.why: The four-input Boolean result needs both vector operations, and the live k1 mask and required scalar flags need their separate tests.

4d89ce7e78.why: Both word broadcasts and both scalar updates produce independent required outputs.

d0a0a5887f.why: The loaded zmm20 value, both word extrema and the index update must all be preserved, preventing load elimination.

d5138904e6.rewrite:
vmovdqu32 zmm18,ZMMWORD PTR [rdx+r10*1]
vpandd zmm22,zmm22,zmm18
vpmaxub zmm17,zmm18,ZMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*1]
vpternlogq zmm16,zmm17,zmm18,0xf6
add r10,0x40
d5138904e6.why: Unsigned byte maximum is commutative, so the rdi load can be folded into vpmaxub while preserving the final zmm17 and zmm18 values.

3403a6b51d.why: The vector result, mask, Boolean byte, accumulator and scalar updates are all live, and the mask-to-flags test is needed for setne.

21f150b799.rewrite:
vmovdqu32 zmm18,ZMMWORD PTR [rdx+r10*1]
vpandd zmm22,zmm22,zmm18
vpmaxuw zmm17,zmm18,ZMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*1]
vpternlogq zmm16,zmm17,zmm18,0xf6

21f150b799.why: Unsigned word maximum is commutative, allowing the rdi load to be folded into vpmaxuw without changing any required result.

b658bbb07a.why: The loads must widen bytes before multiplication, all resulting outputs are live, and the accumulator already uses a single ternary-logic instruction.

31c292cec1.why: The widened products and live outputs are required, and the allowed ISA has no unsigned saturating dword subtraction to shorten the maximum/subtraction pair.

938eb763d5.why: All initialized registers are live, and SSE4.1 cannot broadcast the four-byte constant in one instruction without loading additional addresses.

e4cb1e9d8a.why: Each broadcast, pointer load, extension and zeroing produces a required register value, while the comparison supplies the required flags.

d5539ae73a.why: Producing both the low-four-bit remainder and the aligned original rsi still requires three scalar instructions, in addition to the live constant load.

85bfbc1ca0.why: SSE2 needs the existing word-broadcast sequences, and the sign extensions, zeroed registers, scalar split and final comparison all produce required outputs.

movdqa xmm2,xmm1
punpcklbw xmm1,xmm0
punpckhbw xmm2,xmm0
psllw xmm1,0x4
psllw xmm2,0x4
pmulhw xmm1,xmm3
pmulhw xmm2,xmm3
paddw xmm1,xmm4
paddw xmm2,xmm4
packuswb xmm1,xmm2
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [rsi],xmm1

061fef0c79.why: The subtraction already sets ZF according to whether the updated r8d is zero, making the final comparison redundant when only ZF must match.

9e1e487a15.why: The scalar arithmetic, full packed xmm1 result, extracted edx result, byte store and three scalar updates are all required under SSE2.

28dd187f3b.why: Both unpacked halves and their arithmetic are needed, and arbitrary weights and rounding values prevent replacing the sequence with a fixed average.

3bf8016934.why: Each of the four scalar instructions updates a different required register, and the final subtraction also supplies all required flags.
